title: Precision calculations in supersymmetric theories
journal: Adv. High Energy Phys. 2013 (2013) 607807 (from memory; not shown on fetched page)
claim: Review of multi-loop DRED calculations up to four loops: DRED is not supersymmetric to all orders; its known inconsistencies (Siegel: 4d epsilon-metric relations; impossibility of splitting 4d space into infinite-dimensional pieces) become active only at higher orders (traces of >= ten gamma matrices, antisymmetrization over five indices); resolution via a quasi-4-dimensional space Q4 = Qd + Q2eps; Fierz identities fail in Q4 and SUSY may break. Epsilon-scalars must be renormalized as separate fields with evanescent couplings; in SUSY theories Z_g = Z_e should hold to all orders. Four-loop SYM gauge beta in DR-bar agrees precisely with the NSVZ-derived result, called a remarkable check of both calculations.
theory: SUSY QCD / MSSM / SYM in DRED
scheme: DRED (DR-bar) with epsilon-scalars and evanescent couplings; gamma5: HV-type in DRED needs d<4 (problematic), naive anticommuting gamma5 with O(d-4) trace ambiguity (eqs. 3.9-3.11); HV needed for three-loop finite parts with two fermion-triangle subdiagrams.
symmetry_argument: Supersymmetry identities checked as equalities of renormalization constants (Z_g = Z_e) and agreement with NSVZ + redefinition; QAP-type argument that Fierz violation in Q4 is the source of SUSY breaking (Sec. 3.1).

assumed: That DRED inconsistencies only matter at higher orders (traces with >= 10 gamma matrices / 5 antisymmetrized indices) is stated as a counting argument (Sec. 3.1), not a derivation of where SUSY breaks.
checked_partially: beta_e^SYM = beta_s^SYM checked at two and three loops only (eq. 3.47; evanescent checks available only for alpha_e).
Four-loop SYM gauge beta (eq. 3.49) agrees with NSVZ-based ref. [133]; D4(AA), zeta3, zeta4, zeta5 dependence cancels in SYM (Sec. 3.3.4).
HV-gamma5 Adler-Bardeen check to two loops under assumption eq. (3.8).

evidence: Sec. 2: DRED not supersymmetric to all orders; NSVZ exact relations do not hold for DRED.
Sec. 3.1, eq. (3.1): quasi-4-dim space; Fierz failure; gamma5 discussion eqs. (3.8)-(3.11).
Sec. 3.3, eqs. (3.17)-(3.22b): DRED Lagrangian split, epsilon-scalars; after eq. (3.28): Z_g = Z_e in SUSY theories.
Sec. 3.3.3: identifying alpha_e with alpha_s gives finite gauge-independent errors in beta_s and non-local terms / divergent anomalous dimension for the quark mass at three loops.
red_flags: No source here establishes the loop order at which DRED actually breaks SUSY; 'higher orders' is a counting estimate.
Four-loop SUSY check is restricted to the gauge beta of pure SYM and relies on NSVZ+redefinition on the other side.
cross_checks: S1e.05_HJKMS2006, S1e.06_JJKM2007, S1e.07_HMS2009; DRED consistency papers (Siegel, Avdeev et al., Stockinger) are in section S2.
notes: Lead correct. The review cites the Q4 construction without naming Stockinger in the extracted text.
